title: Project states & relationships
question: What changes, and what connects to what?
description: Follow portfolio stages, stakeholder perspectives, scope-to-benefit assumptions and a small delivery checklist.

title: Decisions & trade-offs
question: What are we deciding, and what do we give up?
description: Frame a decision, compare competing objectives, and separate delay distributions from dependence.

title: Delivery dynamics & feedback
question: How does the project change as work happens?
description: Explore learning, rework, reviews and site occupancy through deliberately small models.

title: Data, evidence & assurance
question: What would make the picture trustworthy?
description: Use a maturity discussion and a project-controls learning map to examine how information supports decisions.

title: Capabilities & AI futures
question: What might tools change, and what still needs judgement?
description: Distinguish a capability map, a sourced software timeline and a speculative market scenario.
